explorationControls.question: Where does this exact text occur in current project text, and which aligned compiler symbol owns each line?
explorationControls.requiredInput: One exact text literal or deliberately bounded regular expression; insert `--` before a literal that starts with a dash.
explorationControls.returnedFact: exact cardinality, bounded identities and source, and scope commands that recover withheld matches
explorationControls.evidenceCeiling: Exact current-text cardinality and locations within reported text coverage; compiler ownership only where aligned.
explorationControls.nonClaim: Structural source ranking orders exact matches but does not establish task relevance. A literal co-occurrence does not establish a graph relationship.
contrasts: outline: search locates exact text across files; outline enumerates compiler-owned constructs in one known file.

explorationControls.question: What symbols and nesting exist in this file?
explorationControls.requiredInput: One exact current project file path.
explorationControls.returnedFact: symbol names, nesting, and line ranges
explorationControls.evidenceCeiling: Exact compiler-owned constructs and ranges when the file is indexed; no invented semantic overlay.
explorationControls.nonClaim: File ownership and nesting do not establish execution or task relevance.
contrasts: search: outline enumerates constructs in one known file; search locates exact text across current project text.
code: outline returns identities and ranges; code materializes exact source for selected identities.

explorationControls.question: Which detected external roots or entry-surface candidates match this text?
explorationControls.requiredInput: Optional exact text to filter candidates; otherwise the current indexed repository.
explorationControls.returnedFact: entry symbols with files, confidence, evidence, and observed static caller counts
explorationControls.evidenceCeiling: Source/compiler-grounded entry evidence and observed static caller counts; exported-only candidates remain candidates.
explorationControls.nonClaim: A package-public export or zero indexed callers is an entry candidate, not proof of runtime ingress. Entry classification does not establish that the callable executes.
contrasts: entry-map: entrypoints locates possible external roots; entry-map traverses static calls from one selected root.
search: entrypoints classifies callable roots; search only locates exact text and ownership.

explorationControls.question: Which exact execution, runtime, data, state, temporal, contract, identity, ownership, or dependency relationships surround these referents? Which related source must be read only when graph evidence leaves a named implementation gap?
explorationControls.requiredInput: One or more exact symbol, file:line, or literal roots plus explicit family, direction, depth, and output bound.
explorationControls.returnedFact: batched exact selectors and typed graph relationships; compact endpoints with exact locations and follow-up commands; coverage and recoverable omissions; exact source-recovery command when source was requested with a graph projection; explicit ambiguity failure with exact rerun commands
explorationControls.evidenceCeiling: Typed edges only to each registered provider ceiling within the explicitly selected projection and reported coverage.
explorationControls.nonClaim: The projection does not infer which relationships are relevant to the user task. Reference, dependency, data, state, temporal, contract, and identity edges do not become execution claims.
contrasts: refs: refs enumerates direct reference sites; evidence traverses explicitly selected typed relationships.
call-graph: call-graph specializes in static calls; evidence can combine execution with other selected families.
dependence-slice: dependence-slice computes a program-dependence slice; evidence performs bounded graph projection.

explorationControls.question: Which related source units across several known text, symbol, or location anchors should be read together?
explorationControls.requiredInput: One or more exact text, symbol, or file:line selectors naming the unresolved behavior.
explorationControls.returnedFact: one ranked, deduplicated semantic packet plus exact selector cardinality and explicit expansion coverage
explorationControls.evidenceCeiling: Complete current source for every materialized syntax unit; bounded selector and packet coverage remain explicit.
explorationControls.nonClaim: A source packet does not choose which implementation details are relevant to the user task. A reference mention does not establish executable reachability.
contrasts: code: inspect batches bounded behavior or source gaps; code materializes complete exact source.
evidence: inspect reads implementation units; evidence projects typed relationships without source.

explorationControls.question: What exact source defines these symbols, ranges, or file surfaces?
explorationControls.requiredInput: One or more exact symbols, file:line ranges, or file paths.
explorationControls.returnedFact: per-selector resolution, complete definition source, exact ranges, optional same-file call closure, file export surfaces, and omitted-local ledgers
explorationControls.evidenceCeiling: Exact current source bytes for every resolved selector, with omitted file-local constructs disclosed.
explorationControls.nonClaim: Source materialization does not establish callers, runtime reachability, or task relevance by itself.
contrasts: inspect: code materializes complete exact source; inspect batches bounded behavior or source gaps.
outline: code reads selected implementations; outline enumerates file structure without reading every body.

unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.capability: Whole-program definition-use flow through arbitrary calls and returns is unavailable.
unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.consequence: Missing dataflow edges cannot establish that a value never crosses an unmodeled call.

unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.capability: Heap points-to and cross-instance alias analysis are unavailable.
unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.consequence: Missing field or state edges cannot establish that two references never reach the same object.

unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.capability: Interprocedural exception propagation and finally completion flow are unavailable.
unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.consequence: Normal-path reachability and ordering do not establish behavior after a throw or rejection.

unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.capability: Reflective lookup, dynamic loading, and name-computed invocation are unavailable without exact evidence.
unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.consequence: Missing static edges cannot establish that a construct is unreachable through reflection.

unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.capability: Dispatch tables or names created only by generated or unavailable source are unavailable.
unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.consequence: Missing dispatch edges cannot establish that no generated consumer exists.

unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.capability: Framework runtime crossings without a registered source adapter are unavailable.
unavailableRelationshipFrontiers.consequence: Missing boundary edges cannot establish that no producer, consumer, state effect, or ordering exists.
